## ATS / Editing Conventions (do not regress)
- **Never reduce ATS strength.** When trimming, **merge** bullets to preserve keywords + quantified metrics; do not delete numbers or tech terms.
- Bold key metrics and technologies with `\textbf{}`.
- Keep standard section headings (EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, PROJECTS, CERTIFICATIONS, EDUCATION).
- Keep the resume to **one page**.
- Attribute achievements to the correct role/timeframe (e.g., foundational build/validation work → Associate SE; architecture/leadership → Software Engineer I).
